title: patch_file old_string not found on signal catalogue file
description: patch_file failed with 'old_string not found' on .moeb/signals/catalogue/a1000012-0529-4000-8000-000000000012.signal.json when adding picked_up_at and fix_branch fields. The moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize spec is active but did not prevent this failure on a Windows CRLF file.
proposed_resolution: Add a regression test to patch_file.rs covering a CRLF file with an LF old_string. Verify normalize_line_endings is applied to both the file content and the old_string before matching.
